instruction: Change Chrome's default font size to Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent encountered Access Denied on drugs.com. Tried Google search (got SSL error), alternative URLs (npg.nature.com - also blocked), then opened terminal and used curl to fetch content from Wikipedia, NIAID, nature.com, and KEGG over 50 turns. Never reached drugs.com/npc/ or /npp/.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can click Chrome address bar, type URLs, perform Google search attempts, open terminal, run curl/bash commands, navigate between windows
metadata.failure_analysis: drugs.com blocked VM IP (Access Denied). Google.com had SSL certificate error in browser. External websites largely inaccessible in this VM environment.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original browsing task into a Chrome settings modification task. Requires navigating to chrome://settings (internal, no network) and changing font size. Tests UI interaction capability in a network-independent context.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default font size to Large (20). Evaluator uses check_font_size with chrome_font_size getter to verify the setting was changed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_chrome_font_size) correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts webkit.webprefs dict containing default_font_size - this is the right state for verifying font size changes.
Metric (check_font_size) correctly accesses font_size['default_font_size'] and compares against rule['value'] (20) using exact equality, which is appropriate for a discrete setting.
Expected value of 20 is correct: Chrome's 'Large' font size maps to 20px.

Parameter handling is correct: check_font_size(font_size, rule) receives the rules dict {'type': 'value', 'value': 20} directly as the rule parameter, and accesses rule['type'] and rule['value'] correctly.
No postconfig needed - getter reads the Preferences file directly from disk, independent of UI state.
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (change font size to Large) is fully verified by the single evaluator check.
